caption: The worked example in six steps, top to bottom: the periods in Dr. and in the e-mail are shielded, four protected patterns stay whole, and the repeats of in and Chennai give 14 tokens but only 12 types.

spec.title: Worked example: 14 tokens, 12 types
spec.aria: A top to bottom flow for the worked example: the raw sentence, sentence splitting to one sentence, protecting the four patterns Dr., ₹1,250.50, 3/5/24 and rao@site.in, splitting the semicolon and final full stop as their own tokens, a token list of 14 tokens, and a type count of 12 because in and Chennai each repeat.
